_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROJECT SCOPE STATEMENT' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.02.05.

f01_Detailed_Project_Scope_Description.label: Detailed Project Scope Description
f01_Detailed_Project_Scope_Description.guidance: Comprehensive narrative of the project work, characteristics of the end solution, and boundaries.

f02_Major_Project_Objectives_and_Outcome.label: Major Project Objectives and Outcomes
f02_Major_Project_Objectives_and_Outcome.guidance: Target business and technical outcomes directly addressed by executing this scope.

f03_Core_Product_Deliverables.label: Core Product Deliverables
f03_Core_Product_Deliverables.guidance: The primary end-products, technical systems, or physical deliverables generated by the project.

f04_Project_Management_and_Governance_De.label: Project Management and Governance Deliverables
f04_Project_Management_and_Governance_De.guidance: Management plans, status reports, audit logs, and compliance documentation delivered.

f05_Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria.label: Measurable Acceptance Criteria
f05_Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria.guidance: Specific, objective, and testable quality conditions required before deliverable formal acceptance.

f06_Acceptance_Authority_and_Process.label: Acceptance Authority and Process
f06_Acceptance_Authority_and_Process.guidance: Designated stakeholder authority and formal inspection workflow required for sign-off.

f07_Explicit_Out_of_Scope_Items.label: Explicit Out-of-Scope Items
f07_Explicit_Out_of_Scope_Items.guidance: Explicitly documented features, services, or activities that are intentionally excluded from project scope.

f08_Boundaries_and_Excluded_Support.label: Boundaries and Excluded Support
f08_Boundaries_and_Excluded_Support.guidance: Operational boundaries clarifying responsibilities not assumed by the project team.

f09_Identified_Project_Constraints.label: Identified Project Constraints
f09_Identified_Project_Constraints.guidance: Imposed boundaries including hard deadlines, budget caps, regulatory compliance, and technology limits.

f10_Identified_Project_Assumptions.label: Identified Project Assumptions
f10_Identified_Project_Assumptions.guidance: Critical planning assumptions regarding resource availability, vendor performance, and dependencies.
